sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C11923 and card C11923-K2. On December 29, 2016, the customer contacted the bank to report an unauthorized online purchase of $131.30 (ID 3583368). Investigation revealed an episode of four online transactions on the same day between 00:53:52 and 03:27:44, totaling $235.66 in exposure. The disputed $131.30 transaction occurred from a device profile marked as new for this account (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android | ). This specific device profile is highly suspicious, as it was used on two other cards (C03938-K1 and C05595-K1) belonging to different customers on December 28, 2016. The rapid succession of online transactions using various device profiles further supports the conclusion of unauthorized card-not-present use. The bank has blocked the compromised card and is monitoring the connected accounts.

stop_reason: The investigation ended because the customer confirmed the fraud and the total exposure of $235.66 is under the $2,500 threshold for further escalation.
